gymnastics:
Tabata 20 seconds on - 10 seconds off x 4 mins (00:00)
Hollow & Arch Hold
Double Under Progression
Odd Min Singles - focus on jumping higher (5:00-15:00)
Even Mins Penguin Clap Drill
Double Under attempts - (15:00-20:00)
Double - single - single - single - Double
for the DU Experts - go for max sets every 2-3 mins
T2B Bar Progression
1-2 mins False Grip on bar - focus on Knuckles Up (21:00)
EMOM x 3 (23:00)
10 x Beat Swing
EMOM x 3 (26:00)
Jump Into Hollow/Arch x 10
EMOM x 3 (29:00)
Bigger Beat Swing - Push Down on Bar
- Put Ball between feet - Reach Long in the Arch - Dont bend the knees
EMOM x 3 (32:00)
Knees to Chest - Aggressive & Pop - pause at the top
EMOM x 3 (35:00-38:00)
Beat Swing with Straight legs - to target
Aim for height without losing tension.
the goal is to chain them together
